notes: Group 1: «أبي» and «محمد بن عبد الله» are co-transmitters of «حدثني» (جميعا); «أخيه علي» is one link (علي).
Group 1 ends at ليث: the encounter speaker («استقبلته ... فقال») is a pronoun only, so no name is written. This is a first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker (rule 11).
Group 2: «أخبرني فلان عن فلان عن عائشة» is the speaker's own chain for a second saying (the Prophet's words via عائشة); the two «فلان» are gaps, not names.
